{title_of_event}

Date: {scheduled_date}

{event_details}
{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation(title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines and formatting). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date for the event. extra_info : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user.
